title: Domain, hosting and builders: who owns what

sections.skill: Know the parts of a website and who controls each

questions.prompt: What is a domain?

choices.text: The computer that stores the website's files
A legal entity like an LLC
The company that designs the logo

questions.correct_answer: The website's address
questions.intro: A website has parts. The DOMAIN is the address (yourshop.example), rented yearly from a registrar. HOSTING is the service that stores the site and shows it to visitors. A WEBSITE BUILDER combines hosting and design tools. Check WHO OWNS each part: the domain should be registered in the business owner's name and account, not only a designer's. Keep the login details safe, turn on auto-renewal or a reminder, and know how to export your content if you switch builders.

questions.prompt: The street address is like what?
questions.correct_answer: The domain
questions.intro: Think of a shop. The street address is the domain: how people find it. The building is the hosting: where the shop actually sits. The furniture and decorations are the design. If the address is registered in someone else's name, they could redirect your customers. That is why the business owner should hold the address in her own name.
